b: Acme Tools has a new Fein Turbo vacuum doorbuster deal.
With this promo, you buy the Fein Turbo I 5.8 gallon vacuum at $299.95, and get a free “construction accessory set” with nozzles and extension wands.
I’ve had great experiences with Fein vacuums in the past, and used them for general cleanup tasks as well as on-tool dust extraction.

I also like that it has an auxiliary port. Basically, you plug in a corded tool, such as a sander, and the vacuum can activate automatically when the tool starts. Or switch it to manual mode for cleaning tasks.
Thank you to Brossa for the heads-up!
